    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_basic_bongartz_completion (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) :
    ∃ (T : TwoTerm R) (l : List (HomotopyCategory (FGModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))), T.BasicDecomposition l ∧ T.IsPresilting ∧ IsInAdd P.homotopyObject T.homotopyObject ∧ (∀ (X : TwoTerm R), T.InThick X) ∧ ∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), IsGeneratedBy (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel T.differential) M ↔ Subsingleton (M ⟶ nakayamaKernel k P)

    There is a basic two-term silting completion containing the original complex in its additive closure, and its cokernel generates precisely the left Hom-perpendicular of the original Nakayama kernel.
